Villas & Condos for Sale in Layan, Phuket

4 development projects in Layan
HomeLocationsLayan

Layan at a glance

Our catalogue currently lists 4 development projects in Layan: 2 villas, 2 condominiums. Advertised starting prices run from ฿4,500,000 to ฿98,000,000 (4 of 4 projects publish a price; the rest are on request). Ownership offered by the developers: freehold and leasehold, so please confirm the exact title with your lawyer before buying.

About Layan

Layan is the beach area on Phuket's west coast north of Bang Tao, in Choeng Thale, Thalang district; Layan Beach borders a national park. Projects listed here are described as located on or very close to Layan Beach or Layan Bay: pool-villa communities (Aileen Villas Layan, Pavara Vhana Collection), the branded beachfront condominium Kiara Reserve Residences next to the Anantara Layan resort, and the sea-view Ayana Heights, about 1.4 km (2 minutes by car) from Layan Beach in the project data.

This is the premium end of our catalogue, with advertised starting prices from about THB 4.5 million for Ayana Heights up to THB 98 million. Projects that are only near Layan Beach, such as Layan Green Park, are listed under their primary location (Cherng Talay) and mention Layan as a nearby area.

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Bang Tao · Nai Yang
